inputs.commit_message: Execute ASOL control cutover from canonical local workspace
inputs.shell_command:
set -euo pipefail
cd /home/hesham/gova
echo '=== canonical workspace preflight ==='
git fetch --prune origin main
branch=$(git branch --show-current)
echo branch=$branch
test "$branch" = main
if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)" ]; then
  echo 'Tracked changes exist in canonical workspace; refusing production cutover.'
  git status --short --untracked-files=no
  exit 42
fi
git pull --ff-only origin main
echo head=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
echo origin_main=$(git rev-parse origin/main)
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git rev-parse origin/main)"
if [ ! -f .vercel/project.json ]; then echo root_vercel_link=missing; exit 43; fi
echo root_vercel_link=present
echo '=== atomic production cutover from canonical workspace ==='
NEXT_PUBLIC_ASOL_CONTROL_URL=https://asol-control.vercel.app NEXT_PUBLIC_ASOL_SUBMAIN_URL=https://asol-submain.vercel.app NEXT_PUBLIC_ASOL_SUB2MAIN_URL=https://asol-sub2main.vercel.app npm run deploy:all
